relations.relationship: Treats masculine status as relational and historically produced across home, work and male associations.
relations.evidence_note: Selected primary text, printed pp. 183–188, read in a public OCR transcription, including the linked-arena argument and cautions about manliness as a master concept. OCR was not collated against page images; no exact quotation or entire-article reading claimed.

relations.relationship: Advocates historical context, debated interpretations and bounded analogy as resources for democratic citizenship.
relations.evidence_note: Own policy essay, Introduction, History and citizenship, Role of historians and ending read. His Iraq example and assessment of education remain attributed; no current policy advice or automatic lesson from the past.
